statement: A bounded 2D projected density, even with both coordinate marginals bounded, is not sufficient receiver-side information for universal nonlinear quadratic integration at a nonzero scalar pivot. An explicit cap-one dependent plane law and independent cap-one scalar give the fixed spectrum {1,1,-1} form X^2+2UV with peak at least (1/2)sqrt(log R).
exact_diagnostic: For the same family E|2UV+2R|^{-1/2}=2sqrt(log R), identifying rank-two half-Riesz control as product provenance lost by the cap-only abstraction.
positive_replacement: If X is independent cap-one and Q=a(X+D)^2+W, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= |a|^{-1/2} sup_t E|W-t|^{-1/2}. Applying QFORM-RANK2-AFFINE-HALF-RIESZ-v1 to a genuine product projection gives 128|a|^{-1/2}|det H|^{-1/4}, or 16sqrt(30) in-range.

partner_result_applied.application: Its genuine spectral-plane cap ||rho_Y||_infinity<=2 is shown insufficient by itself because the barrier already has cap 1 and fixed determinant 1 while output peaks diverge.

unresolved_implication: Exploit the joint relation between scalar coupling and the genuine rank-two product-projection half-Riesz geometry to remove the |a|^{-1/4} loss as a approaches zero; cap-only interpolation is impossible.
